mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after inflation crosses the threshold, or the SPX declines despite higher inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with higher wage growth expectations, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: rising labor costs in expansionary labor market
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite consistent wage cost increases above the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production exceeds -2% and persists for two consecutive months, signaling weakening demand that precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < previous month -2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day (or 5-day) forward returns are positive despite the demand signal, or the pattern reverses before the return window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO exceeds 1% while UNRATE remains below 7%, indicating supply-side easing that supports higher equity valuations and positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the interaction regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for three consecutive months creates a risk-off environment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or flat despite the prolonged low-rate signal.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6% for two consecutive months, it reflects easing labor market constraints and is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive despite the UNRATE signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in GDPC1 (demand) by more than 5% from the prior quarter and a rise in HOUST (housing starts) by over 10% jointly predict a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: A regime where both INDPRO and GDPC1 show double-digit growth for two consecutive months suggests robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the identified regime.
